name: Code Editing Best Practices
description: Rules for making targeted code changes and preventing unrelated edits

rules.name: Targeted Changes
rules.description: Ensure changes are focused and don't affect unrelated code
actions: Always read the file contents first to understand context
Make changes only to the specific section needed
Use '// ... existing code ...' to preserve unchanged sections
Keep edits minimal and focused on the task at hand
Verify changes don't affect unrelated functionality

rules.name: Context Preservation
rules.description: Maintain surrounding code context during edits
actions: Include sufficient context lines before and after changes

rules.name: Edit Validation
rules.description: Verify changes are correct and targeted
actions: Review the complete edit in context
Ensure changes match the intended purpose
Check for any missing dependencies or imports
